mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profit margins and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has been below 4.5% for two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS have increased by at least 1% month-over-month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 105), supply chain bottlenecks ease, reducing input costs and boosting corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months signals robust job growth that expands consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS has increased for 6 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential construction permits (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown in manufacturing and housing, reducing corporate earnings growth and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST have declined by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 470000 million dollars) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 1200 thousand units), demand for goods and services accelerates, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 470000 and HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
